scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate -w api && npm run prisma:push -w api && npm run seed -w api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start:prod -w api" "npm run start -w web"
